gloss: to forget to write; to leave unwritten

definitions.gloss: to forget to write (something); to neglect to write down
definitions.explanation: To fail to write something because one forgot. Formed from {書|か}く (to write) plus {忘|わす}れる (to forget), following the common 〜{忘|わす}れる pattern of forgetting to do an action.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot to write my name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{用件|ようけん}→用件：15058_youken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot to write the important matter in my notes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{忘|わす}れたまま、⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I submitted the document while having forgotten to write in my address.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧): X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{忘|わす}れる.

Compound of ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write) + ⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ (to forget). Part of the productive 〜⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ pattern.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{忘|わす}れる: to forget to write one's name
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{忘|わす}れる: to forget to write ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧: to forget to say — the same ⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ pattern for speaking
- ⟦{書|か}き{漏|も}らす→書き漏らす：26053_kakimorasu⟧: to omit in writing — leaving something out, not necessarily through forgetfulness
